description.en: Agent control for the Browser panel DSH ships in the right Sidebar: snapshot refs, click/hover/type/press/select/scroll, screenshots (incl. full page), shadow DOM, query-scoped reads and change diffs, 12-step batches, and tabs scoped to the conversation that opened them.
description.zh: 控制 DSH 右栏内置 Browser 的 Agent 插件：快照 refs、点击/悬停/输入/按键/选择/滚动、截图（含整页）、shadow DOM、按问题检索阅读与变化对比、一次最多 12 步，标签按开启它的对话隔离。
